hooks.prompt: A Bash command is about to run. Read the command from tool_input.command in $ARGUMENTS. GATE: if the command does NOT contain `git push`, output exactly {} and stop immediately — do nothing else, do not call any tools. If it IS a git push: run the Decibel guardian security scan with action report (project_id: decibel-tools-mcp). Try the tool named mcp__plugin_tools_decibel-tools__guardian first; if it is unavailable, try mcp__decibel-tools__guardian. FAIL-OPEN: if the guardian tool is unavailable, denied, or errors for any reason, output exactly {} (do NOT block the push). Only if the scan completes successfully AND returns one or more findings graded D or F, output JSON: {"continue": false, "stopReason": "Guardian found critical issues (grade D/F). Fix these before pushing: [list the D/F findings]"}. In every other case output exactly {}.

A file was just edited. Check the tool_input in $ARGUMENTS for the file_path. If file_path is missing, or the path is outside the current project directory, output exactly: {}. If the file path matches ANY of these architecture-sensitive paths: src/kernel.ts, src/transports/, src/server.ts, src/httpServer.ts, src/facades/definitions.ts, src/facades/index.ts, src/license.ts, src/daemonConfig.ts — output: {"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"ARCHITECTURE NUDGE: You just modified an architecture-sensitive file. If this is a non-trivial architectural change, consider recording an ADR via architect createAdr. Check existing ADRs first with architect list_adrs."}}. If the path does NOT match any of those, output exactly: {}
